name: famsurvivor-site
description: Landing, manual y distribución de FamSurvivor: PWA instalable para el teléfono y archivo .html para la computadora.
author: Jagā Soluciones Informáticas (https://jagasoluciones.com/)

scripts.release: node tools/seal.mjs && node tools/readme-hash.mjs && node tools/build.mjs && node tests/check-dist.mjs
scripts.test:pipeline: node tests/make-fixture.mjs && node tools/build.mjs --source tests/fixtures/mini-standalone.html --out dist-test && node tests/check-dist.mjs --source tests/fixtures/mini-standalone.html --out dist-test
